title: Z-Image gets better proportions and faces
summary:
Better-shaped Z-Image outputs, steadier reasoning-model requests, clearer Gemini tools, and three new community projects.

Z-Image generation now sizes images around the requested aspect ratio, upscales backgrounds, and restores detected faces. The pipeline also adds a safety check that returns an error for flagged images.

Text requests now use the supported temperature of 1 for o1, o3, o4, and GPT-5 series models, including when callers omit the setting. That prevents unsupported-temperature errors across the affected OpenAI routes.

Gemini-large now uses Google Search and URL Context when no tools are supplied; a custom tools array overrides the defaults. Model capability listings were also corrected so unsupported tool features are not advertised.

highlights.title: Sharper Z-Image portraits
highlights.text: Generate Z-Image pictures at your requested aspect ratio, with upscaled backgrounds and restoration for detected faces. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Gemini-large finds context
highlights.text: `gemini-large` now defaults to Google Search and URL Context when you don't supply tools. Pass your own `tools` array to override those defaults. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
